items.title: Texans roll past Colts 26-3: C.J. Stroud leads the fantasy winners
items.dek: C.J. Stroud led the way with 20.5 PPR points. How it happened, what it means for every fantasy-relevant player, and who to grab off waivers.
body: The Texans rolled past the Colts, 26-3. The Texans move to 4-6, while the Colts fall to 3-8. The 29 combined points came in well under the 44.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it.

The Colts got on the board first, in the first quarter, on a 34-yard field goal by Spencer Shrader. The go-ahead score that held up came with 2:21 left in the first quarter: C.J. Stroud's 42-yard touchdown pass to Nico Collins. The Texans controlled this one, and the Colts found the end zone not at all.

C.J. Stroud gave you what you expected: he finished 21 of 27 for 194 yards and three touchdowns, with an interception, plus 27 yards on the ground. He scored 20.5 PPR points, about what we projected (18.6). It was a huge day for David Montgomery, who carried 26 times for 107 yards, adding three catches for 17 yards. Good for 15.4 PPR points against a 7.3 projection. The bigger story is the workload: 84% of the backfield carries, a true bell-cow share. It was a quiet day for Emari Demercado, who carried five times for 33 yards, adding two catches for -4 yards. Just 4.9 PPR points, 4.1 short of our 9.0 projection. Nico Collins was steady: he caught three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown. That's 14.8 PPR points, right around the 15.7 we expected. Marlin Klein had a monster game: he caught all four of his targets for 24 yards and a touchdown. That's 12.4 PPR points, more than double the 2.9 we projected. Tank Dell came in under expectations: he caught three of four targets for 27 yards. That added up to 5.7 PPR points against a 9.0 projection.

Daniel Jones all but disappeared: he was 12 of 27 for 144 yards, with an interception. Just 4.1 PPR points, 7.0 short of our 11.1 projection. Jonathan Taylor was a letdown: he carried 11 times for 21 yards, adding four catches for 6 yards. That added up to 6.7 PPR points against a 12.8 projection. He handled 73% of the running back carries, and that kind of volume travels week to week. Tyler Warren never got going: he caught one of five targets for 22 yards. That added up to 3.2 PPR points against a 10.3 projection. Ashton Dulin made the most of a small role: he caught two of four targets for 30 yards. He finished with 5.0 PPR points; we had him at 2.5.

body: The Bears held on to beat the Buccaneers 27-24. That puts the Bears at 7-2; the Buccaneers drop to 3-6.

The Bears got on the board first, in the first quarter, on Caleb Williams' 9-yard touchdown pass to Rome Odunze. The offenses traded blows: five touchdowns in all, a good day for anyone with a piece of this game.

Caleb Williams was a letdown: he finished 22 of 37 for 279 yards and two touchdowns, with four interceptions. Just 12.8 PPR points, 5.6 short of our 18.4 projection. D'Andre Swift never got going: he carried 12 times for 31 yards. That added up to 3.1 PPR points against a 17.0 projection. The bigger story is the workload: 100% of the backfield carries, a true bell-cow share. Luther Burden III stole the show: he caught seven of nine targets for 97 yards and a touchdown. That's 20.7 PPR points, well above the 11.5 we projected. Rome Odunze came through: he caught four of seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown. He finished with 16.0 PPR points; we had him at 12.1; a new season high. Colston Loveland had a modest day: he caught four of six targets for 54 yards. That's 9.4 PPR points, right around the 11.2 we expected.

Baker Mayfield was a nonfactor: he was 18 of 32 for 243 yards, with two interceptions. Just 5.7 PPR points, 8.8 short of our 14.5 projection. Bucky Irving was the story: he carried 20 times for 97 yards and two touchdowns, adding four catches for 28 yards. That's 28.5 PPR points, more than double the 14.1 we projected. He handled 80% of the running back carries, and that kind of volume travels week to week. Kenny Gainwell was steady: he carried five times for 16 yards, adding three catches for 60 yards. He scored 10.6 PPR points, about what we projected (9.2). Cade Otton caught four of eight targets for 25 yards. He finished with 6.5 PPR points, close to our 6.6 projection. Tez Johnson outplayed his projection by a mile: he caught two of five targets for 76 yards. That's 9.6 PPR points, 4.8 better than our 4.8 projection. Emeka Egbuka came in under expectations: he caught three of five targets for 38 yards. That added up to 6.9 PPR points against a 12.3 projection.

items.title: Week 9 Sunday: what we learned from 12 games
items.dek: Every score, the best fantasy days, who's rising and falling, injuries to watch and the first waiver targets of the week.
body: 12 games are in the books. The biggest surprise: the Packers beat the Patriots as 3-point underdogs. The Packers-Patriots game was the highest-scoring at 72 points. Kenneth Walker III led every fantasy scorer with 36.3 PPR points.

It was a huge day for Kenneth Walker III, who carried 18 times for 102 yards and a touchdown, adding four catches for 41 yards and a receiving score. That's 36.3 PPR points, well above the 18.8 we projected; a new season high.

C.J. Stroud went off: he finished 21 of 35 for 384 yards and five touchdowns, with an interception, plus 20 yards on the ground. That's 35.4 PPR points, more than double the 15.5 we projected, easily his top game of the year.
Puka Nacua broke out: he caught 14 of 19 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown. Good for 35.0 PPR points against a 20.5 projection.
Jordan Love had a monster game: he went 23 of 29 for 372 yards and three touchdowns, plus a rushing score. That's 34.2 PPR points, more than double the 15.0 we projected, his best game of the season.
Nobody did more damage than CeeDee Lamb, who caught ten of 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown. Good for 33.5 PPR points against a 17.8 projection.
Matthew Golden carried his managers: he caught all ten of his targets for 164 yards and a touchdown. That's 32.4 PPR points, more than double the 13.0 we projected; a new season high.

It was never close: the Bengals beat the Falcons 34-17. The Bengals move to 6-2, while the Falcons fall to 3-6. Ja'Marr Chase caught ten of 12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown (31.5 points). Joe Burrow threw for 271 yards and three touchdowns, plus a rushing score: 29.5 PPR points.

The Broncos beat the Panthers 26-21. That puts the Broncos at 7-2; the Panthers drop to 3-5. Darren Waller caught eight of ten targets for 90 yards and a touchdown (23.0 points). Bryce Young threw for 276 yards and three touchdowns (20.3 points).

The Saints held on to beat the Browns 23-22 in overtime. The Saints are now 3-5, and the Browns slip to 5-4. Shedeur Sanders threw for 297 yards and two touchdowns, and ran for 28 yards (22.7 points). Tyler Shough threw for 265 yards and a touchdown, and ran for 51 yards (19.7 points).

The Cowboys got past the Colts, 27-23. The Cowboys move to 4-5, while the Colts fall to 2-7. CeeDee Lamb caught ten of 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown, good for 33.5 points. Javonte Williams ran for 101 yards on 20 carries and caught four passes for 23 yards, with a touchdown, good for 22.4 points.

The Lions took care of the Dolphins, 19-9. The Lions move to 6-2, while the Dolphins fall to 1-7. The 28 combined points came in well under the 49.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it. Amon-Ra St. Brown caught eight of ten targets for 86 yards (16.6 points). Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 74 yards on 20 carries, with a touchdown: 13.4 PPR points.

The Giants got the better of the Eagles, 19-11. The Giants move to 5-2-1, while the Eagles fall to 2-7. Isaiah Likely caught five of six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown: 16.3 PPR points. Makai Lemon caught six of nine targets for 61 yards: 12.1 PPR points.

The Rams came out on top against the Commanders, 20-13. The Rams move to 5-4, while the Commanders fall to 2-5-1. The 33 combined points came in well under the 48.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it. Puka Nacua caught 14 of 19 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown (35.0 points). Van Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown, good for 16.8 points.

The Chiefs pulled away in the second half to beat the Jets 35-12. The Chiefs move to 6-2, while the Jets fall to 2-7. Kenneth Walker III ran for 102 yards on 18 carries and caught four passes for 41 yards, with three touchdowns (36.3 points). Travis Kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards and a touchdown: 17.3 PPR points.

The 49ers handled the Raiders 38-17. The 49ers move to 7-1, while the Raiders fall to 4-5. Brock Purdy threw for 232 yards and two touchdowns, and ran for 40 yards and a score, good for 25.3 points. Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards on 18 carries and caught two passes for 19 yards, with two touchdowns (22.7 points).

The Texans rolled past the Chargers, 44-22. The Texans move to 3-5, while the Chargers fall to 0-8. The 66 combined points blew past the 40.5-point total, the kind of game fantasy managers dream about. C.J. Stroud threw for 384 yards and five touchdowns (35.4 points). Kayshon Boutte caught four of five targets for 125 yards and two touchdowns: 28.5 PPR points.

The Seahawks beat the Cardinals 17-3. The Seahawks move to 5-4, while the Cardinals fall to 3-6. The 20 combined points came in well under the 39.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it. AJ Barner caught two of four targets for 7 yards and two touchdowns, good for 15.0 points. Drew Lock threw for 175 yards and a touchdown: 12.6 PPR points.

The Packers won outright as 3-point underdogs, beating the Patriots 45-27. The Packers move to 6-3, while the Patriots fall to 5-4. The 72 combined points blew past the 44.5-point total, the kind of game fantasy managers dream about. Jordan Love threw for 372 yards and three touchdowns, plus a rushing score, good for 34.2 points. The Jaguars struck first in the first quarter on Bhayshul Tuten's 1-yard touchdown run. The offenses traded blows all day: four touchdowns in all, which is exactly what fantasy managers want to see.

It's still a committee, though: he took 34% of the running back carries. It was a quiet day for Bhayshul Tuten, who carried 12 times for 29 yards and a touchdown. He scored 14.1 PPR points, about what we projected (12.9). With 28% of the team's targets, he is clearly the first read. Jakobi Meyers did his job: he caught four of six targets for 65 yards. That's 10.5 PPR points, right around the 8.4 we expected.

Joe Fagnano never got going: he finished 10 of 18 for 60 yards, with two interceptions. Just -0.3 PPR points, 9.2 short of our 8.9 projection. Derrick Henry never got going: he carried 17 times for 57 yards. That added up to 5.6 PPR points against an 11.2 projection. He took 65% of the running back carries, the lead role but not all of it. Justice Hill broke out: he carried nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown, adding three catches for 7 yards. That's 18.2 PPR points, more than double the 6.4 we projected; a new season high. It was a quiet day for Zay Flowers, who caught three of six targets for 6 yards. Just 5.3 PPR points, 8.0 short of our 13.3 projection. With 38% of the team's targets, he is clearly the first read.
